description: This file contains source code for handling node invocation requests, including command execution, environment sanitization, and event handling within a larger system. It manages command parsing, security, process spawning, and communication with external components.

methods.name: resolveExecSecurity
methods.description: Resolves a string value to a specific ExecSecurity type, defaulting to 'allowlist'.

methods.name: isCmdExeInvocation
methods.description: Checks if the command-line arguments indicate a Windows cmd.exe invocation.

methods.name: resolveExecAsk
methods.description: Resolves a string value to a specific ExecAsk type, defaulting to 'on-miss'.

methods.name: sanitizeEnv
methods.description: Sanitizes environment variables, blocking path overrides.

methods.name: truncateOutput
methods.description: Truncates a string output to a maximum number of characters, indicating if truncated.

methods.name: parseWindowsCodePage
methods.description: Parses a string to extract Windows code page number.

methods.name: resolveWindowsConsoleEncoding
methods.description: Determines Windows console encoding by executing 'chcp' command.

methods.name: decodeCapturedOutputBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a Buffer to string considering Windows console encoding.

methods.name: redactExecApprovals
methods.description: Redacts sensitive parts of ExecApprovalsFile, such as socket paths.

methods.name: requireExecApprovalsBaseHash
methods.description: Validates that the base hash of exec approvals matches expected snapshot.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes a command with spawn, capturing output, handling timeout, and returning a RunResult.

methods.name: resolveEnvPath
methods.description: Resolves the PATH environment variable into an array of directories.

methods.name: resolveExecutable
methods.description: Resolves the full path of an executable binary based on environment PATH and extensions.

methods.name: handleSystemWhich
methods.description: Finds the full paths of specified binaries.

methods.name: buildExecEventPayload
methods.description: Builds an event payload, truncating output if necessary.

methods.name: sendExecFinishedEvent
methods.description: Sends an 'exec.finished' event with command execution results.

methods.name: runViaMacAppExecHost
methods.description: Requests execution of a command via Mac app execution host socket.

methods.name: sendJsonPayloadResult
methods.description: Sends a JSON payload result to the client.

methods.name: sendRawPayloadResult
methods.description: Sends a raw JSON payload string to the client.

methods.name: sendErrorResult
methods.description: Sends an error result to the client.

methods.name: sendInvalidRequestResult
methods.description: Sends an invalid request error to the client.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main handler for processing invocation requests, dispatching commands, and managing system run workflows.

methods.name: decodeParams
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into typed parameters.

methods.name: coerceNodeInvokePayload
methods.description: Coerces an unknown payload into a NodeInvokeRequestPayload if valid.

methods.name: sendInvokeResult
methods.description: Sends invocation result back to the client.

methods.name: buildNodeInvokeResultParams
methods.description: Constructs parameters for node invoke result message.

methods.name: sendNodeEvent
methods.description: Sends a node event message to the client.
